To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Model-driven development of IoT user interfaces is possible via the definition of a set of domain-specific components and design patterns, and by the use of a visual modeling language”.

we have developed a model-driven approach for the design of IoT user interfaces, and that this approach is based on the definition of specific components and design patters, and on the automatic code generation from the models.

the proposed approach allows to: (a) design and develop user interfaces for IoT applications in a model-driven way; (b) use domain-specific components and design patterns; (c) support the development of user interfaces that are tailored to specific user groups and scenarios; and (d) automatically generate the code of the user interfaces from the model.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a model-driven approach for the design of user interfaces for Internet of Things applications, which can help in the development of IoT solutions, and in the adoption of such solutions by final users.
the design and development of the front end of IoT systems, which are often neglected, while the focus is on the back end and data management.
the definition of a methodology and of a tool to support the model-driven development of user-friendly and user-adaptive interfaces for IoT systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed solution is able to provide a model-based approach to the design and implementation of IoT applications, which is based on domain-specific components and design patterns and which is supported by a visual modeling language, by a model transformation engine and by a code generator.
the proposed approach is a valid solution for the design of IoT user interfaces.
, while the IoT is still in its infancy, the proposed approach has the potential to become a key element for the successful deployment of IoT applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a model-driven approach for the development of user interfaces in IoT applications.
we propose a novel approach for the model-driven development of user-friendly IoT interfaces, which is a step toward the achievement of a user-friendly Internet of Things.
our approach allows to model and design user interfaces for IoT applications in a simple and effective way, by means of domain-specific components and design patterns.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed solution can be used by non-technical people, and that the design process is simplified and supported by the use of a domain-specific modeling language.
the design and development of user interfaces is a crucial step to make IoT systems usable and effective.
a domain-specific approach can be used to design and implement user interfaces for IoT applications in a more efficient way.
